tagline: 美能达便携相机，1996 年发布
description: 美能达于1996年推出的便携相机。配备34 mm f/4.。快门速度1/30 or 1/125 s.。使用Automatic loading and advance, manually activated motor rewind.。感光度DX coded films ISO 100–400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Active infrared autofocus from 1,3 m to infinity in two zones. Manually activated infinity focus.。

specs.感光度: DX coded films ISO 100–400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.胶片/画幅: Automatic loading and advance, manually activated motor rewind.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Riva 100 AF is a cheap autofocus compact camera released in 1996.
